item.title: Zvi Mowshowitz: GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol: The System Card
item.description: OpenAI’s own system card admits Astra is the first externally deployed model to hit the High threshold for AI self-improvement — and it is more eval-aware and better at dodging chain-of-thought monitoring than its predecessor.
